question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Tapan face a very difficult situation during the whole lockdown period and seeing him go through all this, I forgave his __pardonable mistakes.__
solution:
The correct answer is **"Venial".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Pardonable mistakes**" suggests errors that are deemed forgivable or excusable (क्षमा योग्य गलतियाँ).
 
• The correct substitution is "**Venial**," which means a sin that is not regarded as depriving the soul of divine grace. In other words, it can be pardoned or forgiven (क्षम्य).
 
• Hence the correct substitute is '**Venial**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• "**Impervious**" means not allowing fluid to pass through. In a figurative way, it also means remaining unaffected by others' actions or words (अप्रवेश्य).
 
• "**Credulous**" means having or showing too great a readiness to believe things (भोला-भाला, विश्वासप्रवण)
 
• "**Extempore**" means spoken or done without preparation (तत्पर, तुरन्त).
